words.gram: m. nom. sg. pass. pres. part. abhi-ud-√ci

hindi: संचित किया जाता हुआ समाधि-मोक्ष करवाए।
english: Being heaped up, [he] should have the release of the samādhi done.
notes: Subject not stated. abhi-ud-√ci is taken literally ('heaped up, raised'); the sense is uncertain. samādhi is obscure here (literally 'putting together, settlement, concentration'; a pledge or engagement is possible), so the word is kept, not interpreted. mokṣa = release (glossary 3.3). The unit is very short and its connection with the neighbouring units is not clear.

words.gloss: in the guise of artisans and craftsmen

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. part. ātm. √kṛ

words.gloss: having caused to be dug near

hindi: कुमार के निकटवर्ती गुप्तचर, कारु और शिल्पी के वेश वाले, कर्म करते हुए, रात में सुरंग से निकट खुदवाकर कुमार को हर ले जाएँ।
english: Secret agents near the prince, in the guise of artisans and craftsmen, doing works, having had [a way] dug near by a tunnel at night, should carry off the prince.
notes: upakhānayitvā: upa-√khan caus., 'having caused to be dug near'; what is dug (a tunnel) is not stated beyond suruṅgayā. karmāṇi = works (glossary 3.14/7.2 line); the agents are only 'doing works' as part of the disguise. kumāra = prince.
lines_deva: कुमार.आसन्नाः सत्त्रिणः कारु.शिल्पि.व्यञ्जनाः कर्माणि कुर्वाणाः सुरुङ्गया रात्राव् उपखानयित्वा कुमारम् अपहरेयुः
lines_iast: kumāra.āsannāḥ sattriṇaḥ kāru.śilpi.vyañjanāḥ karmāṇi kurvāṇāḥ suruṅgayā rātrāv upakhānayitvā kumāram apahareyuḥ

words.gloss: actors, dancers, singers, players of instruments, those living by speech, kuśīlavas, plavakas and saubhikas

hindi: अथवा नट, नर्तक, गायक, वादक, वाणी से जीविका चलाने वाले, कुशीलव, प्लवक, सौभिक, पहले से भेजे हुए, दूसरे की सेवा में उपस्थित हों।
english: Or actors, dancers, singers, players of instruments, those who live by speech, kuśīlavas, plavakas and saubhikas, previously dispatched, should wait upon the other.
notes: saubhikā is saubhikāḥ with regular visarga loss before v. kuśīlava, plavaka and saubhika are kept as terms (kuśīlava per glossary 5.3; plavaka literally 'leaper', saubhika obscure). naṭa = actor, vādaka = one who plays (instruments). param = 'the other' (the other king), not 'enemy' (glossary 9.2). The compound is read as one dvandva; vāg-jīvana = those whose livelihood is speech.

hindi: वे कुमार की एक के बाद एक सेवा में उपस्थित हों।
english: They should wait upon the prince in succession.
notes: paraṃ.parayā is the regular paramparayā ('in succession, one after another'), printed with the compound dot. The '-' marks an unsandhied join with upatiṣṭheran.

words.gloss: entries, stayings and exits of unfixed time
words.gram: n. acc. pl., dvandva with bahuvrīhi prefix

hindi: उनके अनियत काल वाले प्रवेश, स्थान, निर्गमन स्थापित करे।
english: [He] should establish their entries, stayings and exits at unfixed times.
notes: sthāna = staying (glossary 7.4), not 'place'. aniyata-kāla is taken with all three of praveśa, sthāna, nirgamana; it could also qualify only praveśa. Subject not stated. sthāpayet may also be 'should arrange'.

hindi: तब अथवा उस वेश वाला रात में प्रस्थान करे।
english: Then, or having that guise, [he] should set out at night.
notes: Subject not stated; tad-vyañjana = 'having that guise' (of the persons of the preceding unit, or of the prince); the antecedent of tad is uncertain.

hindi: इससे रूपाजीवाओं और पत्नी के वेश वाले गुप्तचरों की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By that, courtesans and agents in the guise of wives are explained.
notes: Formula 'tena X vyākhyātāḥ' (glossary 4.1). rūpa-ājīvā = courtesan (glossary 10.1). bhāryā-vyañjana: 'agents' is supplied from the X-vyañjana convention of the glossary.

hindi: अथवा उनके वाद्य, माल, फेला को लेकर निकल जाए।
english: Or, having taken their musical instruments, wares and phelā, [he] should go out.
notes: phelā is kept untranslated (glossary 13.2). The compound is read as a dvandva (as in unit 40, where phelā is a list member); 'phelā of the musical instruments and wares' is also possible. bhāṇḍa = wares (glossary 4.6); tūrya = musical instrument.

words.gloss: cooks, ārālikas, bath-attendants, rubbers, bed-spreaders, kalpakas, adorners (compound continues)
words.gram: m. inst. pl. stem, dvandva (continues in next token)

words.gloss: articles, clothes, wares, phelā, beds, seats, uses

hindi: रसोइयों, आरालिकों, स्नान कराने वालों, रगड़ने वालों, बिछौना बिछाने वालों, कल्पकों, प्रसाधकों, जल-सेवकों द्वारा अथवा द्रव्य, वस्त्र, माल, फेला, शयन, आसन, उपभोगों द्वारा बाहर ले जाया जाए।
english: [He] should be carried out by cooks, ārālikas, bath-attendants, rubbers, bed-spreaders, kalpakas, adorners and water-attendants, or by articles, clothes, wares, phelā, beds, seats and uses.

text_flags.why: possible: the line-end continuation mark '-' and the following space belong to the print line break; the compound simply continues. Not a Sanskrit error.

notes: The first dvandva continues across the continuation mark into udaka-paricārakaiḥ (one compound, split by the e-text). sūda = cook (glossary 5.1); ārālika kept (glossary 5.1); phelā kept (glossary 13.2). snāpaka (one who bathes [others]), saṃvāhaka (one who rubs; usually 'shampooer, masseur'), āstaraka (one who spreads), kalpaka (one who arranges; usually 'barber') and prasādhaka (one who adorns) are rendered literally; the usual specialised senses are not applied. The second instrumental series is taken as means ('by'); 'with' is possible. sambhoga = use; Hindi उपभोग. Subject (the prince or the king) not stated. āsana here = seat, not the policy āsana.

words.gloss: in the disguise of an attendant
by the mouth of a tunnel

hindi: अथवा परिचारक के छद्म से कुछ लेकर अरूप समय में निकल जाए, सुरंग के मुख से या रात्रि-उपहार से।
english: Or, in the disguise of an attendant, having taken something at a formless time, [he] should go out, by the mouth of a tunnel or by a night-offering.
notes: paricārakac.chadmanā is paricāraka-chadmanā with regular cch doubling. arūpa-velā is taken literally ('formless time'); the sense (an unusual or dark hour) is uncertain. niśā-upahāra, literally 'night-offering', is obscure; the comma is the e-text's.
lines_deva: परिचारकच्.छद्मना वा किञ्चिद् अरूप.वेलायाम् आदाय निर्गच्छेत्, सुरुङ्गा.मुखेन वा निशा.उपहारेण
lines_iast: paricārakac.chadmanā vā kiñcid arūpa.velāyām ādāya nirgacchet, suruṅgā.mukhena vā niśā.upahāreṇa

hindi: अथवा जलाशय में वारुण योग का आश्रय ले।
english: Or, in a reservoir of water, [he] should adopt the Varuna contrivance.
notes: yoga = contrivance (glossary 12.4/13.2); the nature of the vāruṇa yoga is not stated and is not guessed. āśaya = receptacle, hence reservoir.

words.gloss: by dealing in cooked food and fruit

hindi: अथवा व्यापारी के वेश वाले गुप्तचर पके अन्न और फल के व्यवहार से रक्षकों में विष परोसवाएँ।
english: Or agents in the guise of traders, by dealing in cooked food and fruit, should cause poison to be served among the guards.
notes: rasa = poison (glossary 12.5); vaidehaka = trader (glossary 3.4/8.4). upa-√car caus. is rendered literally 'cause to be served'; the sense 'administer' is implied. vyañjanā is vyañjanāḥ with regular visarga loss before v.

words.gloss: for the purpose of offerings to deities, śrāddha, prahavaṇa
words.gram: n. acc. sg. used adverbially, tat-puruṣa

words.gloss: by the inciting of the guards

hindi: देवताओं के उपहार, श्राद्ध, प्रहवण के निमित्त रक्षकों में मदन-योग से युक्त अन्न और पान या विष लगाकर चला जाए, अथवा रक्षकों को उभारने से।
english: For the purpose of offerings to deities, śrāddha and prahavaṇa, having applied among the guards food and drink joined with a madana compound, or poison, [he] should go away; or by inciting the guards.
notes: prahavaṇa is kept untranslated (glossary). madana kept as a name, its effect not stated; yoga in madana-yoga = compound (glossary 14.1/14.4). protsāhana = inciting (pra-ut-√sah caus.; glossary 13.1 utsāhayati = rouse). The final 'ārakṣaka-protsāhanena vā' is an elliptical alternative: the verb is not repeated.
lines_deva: दैवत.उपहार.श्राद्ध.प्रहवण.निमित्तम् आरक्षिषु मदन.योग.युक्तम् अन्न.पानं रसं वा प्रयुज्य-अपगच्छेत्, आरक्षक.प्रोत्साहनेन वा
lines_iast: daivata.upahāra.śrāddha.prahavaṇa.nimittam ārakṣiṣu madana.yoga.yuktam anna.pānaṃ rasaṃ vā prayujya-apagacchet, ārakṣaka.protsāhanena vā

words.gloss: in the guise of townsmen, kuśīlavas, physicians, cake-dealers

hindi: अथवा नगरवासी, कुशीलव, चिकित्सक, आपूपिक के वेश वाले गुप्तचर रात में समृद्ध घरों को प्रज्वलित करें, या रक्षकों के।
english: Or agents in the guise of townsmen, kuśīlavas, physicians and cake-dealers should set ablaze at night the prosperous houses, or [those] of the guards.
notes: nāgaraka = townsman (cf. paura, glossary 8.1); āpūpika = dealer in cakes (āpūpa), literal. kuśīlava kept (glossary 5.3). 'ārakṣiṇāṃ vā' leaves gṛhāṇi unstated; the genitive could also be read with the whole phrase ('of the prosperous among the guards'?), which is unlikely.
lines_deva: नागरक.कुशीलव.चिकित्सक.आपूपिक.व्यञ्जना वा रात्रौ समृद्ध.गृहाण्य् आदीपयेयुः आरक्षिणां वा
lines_iast: nāgaraka.kuśīlava.cikitsaka.āpūpika.vyañjanā vā rātrau samṛddha.gṛhāṇy ādīpayeyuḥ ārakṣiṇāṃ vā

hindi: अथवा व्यापारी के वेश वाले गुप्तचर पण्य-संस्था को प्रज्वलित करें।
english: Or agents in the guise of traders should set ablaze the establishment of wares.
notes: paṇya = wares (glossary 5.3). saṃsthā is rendered literally 'establishment' (a market or warehouse is meant); Hindi keeps पण्य-संस्था since संस्था alone suggests an organisation.

hindi: अथवा दूसरा शरीर रखकर अपने घर को प्रज्वलित करे, पीछा किए जाने के भय से।
english: Or, having placed another body, [he] should set his own house ablaze, from fear of pursuit.
notes: anupāta is rendered 'pursuit' (literally 'falling after'). Subject not stated.
lines_deva: अन्यद् वा शरीरं निक्षिप्य स्व.गृहम् आदीपयेद् अनुपात.भयात्
lines_iast: anyad vā śarīraṃ nikṣipya sva.gṛham ādīpayed anupāta.bhayāt

words.gloss: by cuttings of joints, excavations and tunnels

hindi: तब जोड़ काटने, खुदाई, सुरंगों से चला जाए।
english: Then [he] should go away by cuttings of joints, excavations and tunnels.
notes: sandhic.cheda is sandhi-cheda with regular cch doubling. sandhi here = joint, junction (cf. glossary 5.3 sandhi-divasa), not treaty or peace. khāta = something dug (excavation); a moat is also possible.

words.gloss: in the guise of [a bearer of] a load of glass, pots, wares

hindi: अथवा काच, घड़े, माल के बोझ के वेश वाला रात में प्रस्थान करे।
english: Or [he], in the guise of [a bearer of] a load of glass, pots and wares, should set out at night.
notes: kāca = glass (the carrying-pole sense is also possible, then 'load on a carrying-pole'). kumbha = pot. bhāṇḍa = wares (glossary 4.6). Subject not stated.

words.gloss: of the shaven-headed and the matted-haired
of the guises of making [oneself] misshapen and diseased, and of forest-goers

hindi: मुण्डित और जटाधारियों के प्रवासनों में प्रविष्ट हुआ, या रात में उस वेश वाला प्रस्थान करे, या कुरूप और रोगी करने, वनचर के छद्मों में से किसी एक से।
english: Or, having entered the pravāsanas of the shaven-headed and the matted-haired, [he] in that guise should set out at night; or by any one of the guises of making [oneself] misshapen and diseased, and of forest-goers.
notes: pravāsana is obscure: 'lodgings' (from pra-√vas) is a guess; elsewhere in the glossary pravāsana = banishment or sending away, which does not fit well. Kept as a term. muṇḍa and jaṭila are adjectives used as nouns; 'ascetics' is not added. The long compound is read as virūpa-karaṇa / vyādhi-karaṇa / araṇya-cara members of chadman; the division is uncertain (araṇya-cara = forest-goer, glossary 4.10). araṇya.carac.chadmanām: cch doubling. The final vā is rendered at the start of the Hindi clause.
lines_deva: मुण्ड.जटिलानां प्रवासनान्य् अनुप्रविष्टो वा रात्रौ तद्.व्यञ्जनः प्रतिष्ठेत, विरूप.व्याधि.करण.अरण्य.चरच्.छद्मनाम् अन्यतमेन वा
lines_iast: muṇḍa.jaṭilānāṃ pravāsanāny anupraviṣṭo vā rātrau tad.vyañjanaḥ pratiṣṭheta, virūpa.vyādhi.karaṇa.araṇya.carac.chadmanām anyatamena vā

words.gloss: in the guise of the deceased

hindi: अथवा मृतक के वेश वाला गुप्तचरों द्वारा बाहर ले जाया जाए।
english: Or, in the guise of the deceased, [he] should be carried out by secret agents.
notes: preta = the deceased (glossary 5.3). gūḍha = secret agent when a person (glossary 12.5).

words.gloss: in the dress of a woman

hindi: अथवा स्त्री के वेश से मृतक के पीछे जाए।
english: Or [he] should follow the deceased in the dress of a woman.
notes: Subject not stated; preta = the deceased (glossary 5.3).

hindi: और वनचर के वेश वाले गुप्तचर इसे, एक ओर जाते हुए को, दूसरी ओर बताएँ।
english: And agents in the guise of forest-goers should point him, going in one direction, [as going] in another.
notes: vana-cara = forest-goer (cf. araṇya-cara, glossary 4.10). apa-√diś = point out (glossary 7.2). The two anyataḥ are read as 'in one direction ... in another'; the supplied '[as going]' is implied.
lines_deva: वन.चर.व्यञ्जनाश् च-एनम् अन्यतो यान्तम् अन्यतो ऽपदिशेयुः

hindi: तब दूसरी ओर जाए।
english: Then [he] should go in another direction.
notes: Subject not stated.

hindi: अथवा चक्रचरों के शकट-बाड़ों से चला जाए।
english: Or [he] should go away by the cart-enclosures of the cakra-wanderers.
notes: cakra-cara = cakra-wanderer (glossary 4.4), sense not guessed. vāṭa = enclosure; śakaṭa = cart. Subject not stated.

hindi: और पीछा निकट होने पर या सत्त्र को ग्रहण करे।
english: And when pursuit is near, or [he] should take hold of a sattra.
notes: sattra kept untranslated (glossary 7.5; 'hiding-place' of 8.5 is not certain here). The vā links this as an alternative to the means in the preceding units; the English follows the Sanskrit order. loc. absolute: pursuit being near.

words.gloss: in the absence of a sattra

hindi: सत्त्र के अभाव में धन या विष-मिली खाद्य-वस्तु दोनों ओर के मार्ग पर फेंक दे।
english: In the absence of a sattra, [he] should cast out money, or a kind of food mixed with poison, on the road on both sides.
notes: hiraṇya = money (glossary 5.2); rasa-viddha = mixed with poison (glossary 12.5). ubhayataḥ-panthānam is taken as 'the road on both sides / in both directions'; the exact sense is uncertain. rasa-viddhaṃ could also qualify hiraṇyam ('money or [something] mixed with poison').
lines_deva: सत्त्र.अभावे हिरण्यं रस.विद्धं वा भक्ष्य.जातम् उभयतः.पन्थानम् उत्सृजेत्
lines_iast: sattra.abhāve hiraṇyaṃ rasa.viddhaṃ vā bhakṣya.jātam ubhayataḥ.panthānam utsṛjet

hindi: तब दूसरी ओर चला जाए।
english: Then [he] should go away in another direction.
notes: Subject not stated.

hindi: अथवा पकड़ा गया साम आदि से पीछा किए जाने को छल ले, या विष-मिले मार्ग-भोजन से।
english: Or, seized, [he] should outwit the pursuit by conciliation and the rest, or by food on the road mixed with poison.
notes: atisandadhyāt = should outwit (glossary 5.1/9.1); sāma-ādi = conciliation and the rest (glossary 8.5). anupāta may mean the pursuit or the pursuers; Hindi takes it as persons. pathy.adana = pathi-adana, literally 'eating on the road' (food for the journey). rasa = poison.
lines_deva: गृहीतो वा साम.आदिभिर् अनुपातम् अतिसन्दध्यात्, रस.विद्धेन वा पथ्य्.अदनेन
lines_iast: gṛhīto vā sāma.ādibhir anupātam atisandadhyāt, rasa.viddhena vā pathy.adanena

hindi: अथवा वारुण योग, अग्नि, दाहों में दूसरा शरीर रखकर शत्रु पर आरोप लगाए: “मेरा पुत्र तुम्हारे द्वारा मारा गया।”
english: Or, in Varuna contrivances, fires [and] burnings, having placed another body, [he] should charge the enemy: “My son has been killed by you.”
notes: The locative compound is read as a dvandva (vāruṇa-yoga, agni, dāha); other divisions (e.g. 'burnings by fire and the Varuna contrivance') are possible. abhi-√yuj is rendered 'charge' (accuse); 'attack' is also possible. The closing iti of the quotation is carried by the quotation marks only (glossary 13.1). Subject not stated.
lines_deva: वारुण.योग.अग्नि.दाहेषु वा शरीरम् अन्यद् आधाय शत्रुम् अभियुञ्जीत "पुत्रो मे त्वया हतः" इति
lines_iast: vāruṇa.yoga.agni.dāheṣu vā śarīram anyad ādhāya śatrum abhiyuñjīta "putro me tvayā hataḥ" iti

words.gloss: with a concealed weapon taken up

hindi: अथवा छिपाया हुआ शस्त्र धारण किए हुए रात में रक्षकों में आगे बढ़कर शीघ्र पातों से, छिपाकर भेजे हुओं के साथ, पीछे हट जाए।
english: Or, with a concealed weapon taken up, having advanced at night among the guards, [he] should withdraw by swift fallings, together with [those] dispatched in secret.
notes: upāttac.channa = upātta-channa (cch doubling). rakṣin = guard. śīghra-pāta (literally 'swift fall, swift flight') is obscure and kept literal; it may qualify gūḍha-praṇihitaiḥ ('with swift-moving secretly dispatched men'). gūḍha-praṇihita = dispatched in secret, i.e. agents (cf. gūḍha-puruṣa, glossary 12.4). Subject not stated.
